title: Rosco 4

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Hey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Oh, you know. Just another twelve hours of walking in circles, logging streets that won’t stay put, feeding data into a machine that doesn’t care. Real fulfilling work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you know. Just another twelve hours of walking in circles, logging streets that won’t stay put, feeding data into a machine that doesn’t care. Real fulfilling work.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Apparently not. Because it doesn’t exist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apparently not. Because it doesn’t exist.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Besides my own patience wearing down to a thread? Yeah. Ever heard of the Cradle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Besides my own patience wearing down to a thread? Yeah. Ever heard of the Cradle?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: I found something. An old lift shaft, wedged between two towers, rusted and forgotten. But when I scanned it, the Carto Carry lit up, pulling schematics I’d never seen: ‘The Cradle Phase 1.’

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found something. An old lift shaft, wedged between two towers, rusted and forgotten. But when I scanned it, the Carto Carry lit up, pulling schematics I’d never seen: ‘The Cradle Phase 1.’

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Could be. But when I tried to cross-check it with Curzona’s records, guess what? Nothing. No mention. No history. Just a big blank space where data should be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could be. But when I tried to cross-check it with Curzona’s records, guess what? Nothing. No mention. No history. Just a big blank space where data should be.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Exactly. And here’s the fun part—when I went back an hour later? Whole damn thing was gone. Just a wall where the shaft used to be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. And here’s the fun part—when I went back an hour later? Whole damn thing was gone. Just a wall where the shaft used to be.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Ha pay. Well it doesn't exist so who cares?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha pay. Well it doesn't exist so who cares?

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: And it’s not just this. It’s the alleys that move, the stairwells that vanish, the buildings that shift ten meters to the left overnight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it’s not just this. It’s the alleys that move, the stairwells that vanish, the buildings that shift ten meters to the left overnight.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: What I can’t do is stop. Curzona doesn’t pay me to ask questions, they pay me to walk, scan, and shut up. And by “pay,” I mean “slowly shave time off my sentence.”

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What I can’t do is stop. Curzona doesn’t pay me to ask questions, they pay me to walk, scan, and shut up. And by “pay,” I mean “slowly shave time off my sentence.”

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Twenty Five years. Out of forever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Twenty Five years. Out of forever.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: Yeah. Makes you wonder—when I finally do get free, will there even be a city left to leave? Or will it have all just… rearranged itself into the sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Makes you wonder—when I finally do get free, will there even be a city left to leave? Or will it have all just… rearranged itself into the sea.

nodes.speaker: Rosco Foreman
nodes.text: I’m starting to think mapping this city is like trying to bottle fog. The second I get it down, it changes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m starting to think mapping this city is like trying to bottle fog. The second I get it down, it changes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You look like hell. Rough day?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You look like hell. Rough day?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You look like hell. Rough day?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You look like hell. Rough day?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. Should I have?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Should I have?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Find anything weird this time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Find anything weird this time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: …But you found it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: …But you found it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A Curzona data center something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Curzona data center something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like it got erased.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like it got erased.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like it's above your pay-grade.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like it's above your pay-grade.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like it's above your pay-grade.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like it's above your pay-grade.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Strange.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Strange.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what will you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what will you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much time have you worked off so far?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much time have you worked off so far?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How much time have you worked off so far?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How much time have you worked off so far?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: …Damn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: …Damn.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're looking well! How's it going?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're looking well! How's it going?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're looking well! How's it going?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're looking well! How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Rings a bell. Is it a place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rings a bell. Is it a place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Rings a bell. Is it a place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Rings a bell. Is it a place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds fairly normal for here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds fairly normal for here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you just stop?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you just stop?

nodes.text: Rosco 4
Rosco 4
// a moment
